<a id="reverse-shell-cmdline"></a>
## Linux Reverse Shell One-Liner

`detection-rules/sigma/linux/execution/reverse_shell_cmdline.yml` | ATT&CK T1059.004 | level **high** | status test

Detects the common reverse-shell one-liners on Linux: bash /dev/tcp
redirection, netcat or ncat with an exec flag, socat exec, and the Python
socket + pty pattern. Mirrors the YARA rules in detection-rules/yara, which
catch the same payloads at rest.

**Splunk**

```spl
CommandLine="*/dev/tcp/*" OR CommandLine IN ("*nc -e *", "*nc.traditional -e *", "*ncat -e *", "*ncat --exec *") OR (CommandLine="*socat*" CommandLine="*exec:*") OR (CommandLine="*socket*" CommandLine="*connect(*" CommandLine="*pty.spawn*")
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where CommandLine like "*/dev/tcp/*" or CommandLine like "*nc -e *" or CommandLine like "*nc.traditional -e *" or CommandLine like "*ncat -e *" or CommandLine like "*ncat --exec *" or CommandLine like "*socat*" and CommandLine like "*exec:*" or CommandLine like "*socket*" and CommandLine like "*connect(*" and CommandLine like "*pty.spawn*"
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

```kusto
DeviceProcessEvents
| where ProcessCommandLine contains "/dev/tcp/" or (ProcessCommandLine contains "nc -e " or ProcessCommandLine contains "nc.traditional -e " or ProcessCommandLine contains "ncat -e " or ProcessCommandLine contains "ncat --exec ") or (ProcessCommandLine contains "socat" and ProcessCommandLine contains "exec:") or (ProcessCommandLine contains "socket" and ProcessCommandLine contains "connect(" and ProcessCommandLine contains "pty.spawn")
```

<a id="webserver-spawns-shell"></a>
## Web Server Process Spawned a Shell or Recon Command

`detection-rules/sigma/linux/persistence/webserver_spawns_shell.yml` | ATT&CK T1505.003 | level **high** | status test

Detects Apache, nginx or PHP-FPM starting a shell, interpreter or recon
command, the behavioural footprint of a web shell being used. Catches web
shells that the YARA rules miss because they are obfuscated or packed.

**Splunk**

```spl
ParentImage IN ("*/apache2", "*/httpd", "*/nginx", "*/lighttpd") OR ParentImage="*/php-fpm*" Image IN ("*/sh", "*/bash", "*/dash", "*/nc", "*/ncat", "*/python3", "*/perl", "*/whoami", "*/id", "*/uname")
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where (ends_with(ParentImage, "/apache2") or ends_with(ParentImage, "/httpd") or ends_with(ParentImage, "/nginx") or ends_with(ParentImage, "/lighttpd") or ParentImage like "*/php-fpm*") and (ends_with(Image, "/sh") or ends_with(Image, "/bash") or ends_with(Image, "/dash") or ends_with(Image, "/nc") or ends_with(Image, "/ncat") or ends_with(Image, "/python3") or ends_with(Image, "/perl") or ends_with(Image, "/whoami") or ends_with(Image, "/id") or ends_with(Image, "/uname"))
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

```kusto
DeviceProcessEvents
| where ((InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "/apache2" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "/httpd" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "/nginx" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "/lighttpd") or InitiatingProcessFolderPath contains "/php-fpm") and (FolderPath endswith "/sh" or FolderPath endswith "/bash" or FolderPath endswith "/dash" or FolderPath endswith "/nc" or FolderPath endswith "/ncat" or FolderPath endswith "/python3" or FolderPath endswith "/perl" or FolderPath endswith "/whoami" or FolderPath endswith "/id" or FolderPath endswith "/uname")
```

<a id="sudo-abuse"></a>
## Sudo Used to Spawn a Root Shell or Tamper with Privileges

`detection-rules/sigma/linux/privilege-escalation/sudo_abuse.yml` | ATT&CK T1548.003 | level **medium** | status test

Detects sudo being used to start an interactive root shell, set SUID bits,
edit sudoers / shadow or grant sudo group membership, plus users who are
not in sudoers attempting it. Ordinary sudo use (package updates, service
restarts) is not matched.

**Splunk**

```spl
("COMMAND=" "COMMAND=/bin/bash" OR "COMMAND=/bin/sh" OR "COMMAND=/usr/bin/bash" OR "COMMAND=/usr/bin/sh" OR "COMMAND=/bin/su" OR "COMMAND=/usr/bin/su" OR "-exec /bin/sh" OR "-exec /bin/bash" OR "chmod +s" OR "chmod u+s" OR "chmod 4755" OR "/etc/sudoers" OR "visudo" OR "/etc/shadow" OR "usermod -aG sudo" OR "NOPASSWD") OR "user NOT in sudoers" OR "incorrect password attempts"
```

**Elastic (Lucene)**

```text
(*COMMAND\=* AND (*COMMAND\=\/bin\/bash* OR *COMMAND\=\/bin\/sh* OR *COMMAND\=\/usr\/bin\/bash* OR *COMMAND\=\/usr\/bin\/sh* OR *COMMAND\=\/bin\/su* OR *COMMAND\=\/usr\/bin\/su* OR *\-exec\ \/bin\/sh* OR *\-exec\ \/bin\/bash* OR *chmod\ \+s* OR *chmod\ u\+s* OR *chmod\ 4755* OR *\/etc\/sudoers* OR *visudo* OR *\/etc\/shadow* OR *usermod\ \-aG\ sudo* OR *NOPASSWD*)) OR (*user\ NOT\ in\ sudoers* OR *incorrect\ password\ attempts*)
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

<a id="dns-tunneling"></a>
## DNS Query with an Oversized Encoded Label

`detection-rules/sigma/network/dns_tunneling.yml` | ATT&CK T1071.004, T1048.003 | level **high** | status test

Detects DNS queries whose first label is 45-63 characters of letters and
digits, the shape produced when tools such as dnscat2 and iodine encode data
into subdomains, plus dnscat2's default domain prefix. Large CDN and
platform domains that legitimately use long hashed labels are filtered.
Per-query detection only: volume-based tunnelling is covered by Suricata
SID 1000003 and the beacon hunter in scripts/threat-hunting.

**Splunk**

```spl
| rex field=query "(?<queryMatch>^[A-Za-z0-9-]{45,63}\\.)"
| eval queryCondition=if(isnotnull(queryMatch), "true", "false")
| search queryCondition="true" OR query="dnscat.*" NOT (query IN ("*.amazonaws.com", "*.cloudfront.net", "*.akamaiedge.net", "*.windowsupdate.com", "*.microsoft.com", "*.googleusercontent.com"))
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where (query rlike "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{45,63}\\." or starts_with(query, "dnscat.")) and not (ends_with(query, ".amazonaws.com") or ends_with(query, ".cloudfront.net") or ends_with(query, ".akamaiedge.net") or ends_with(query, ".windowsupdate.com") or ends_with(query, ".microsoft.com") or ends_with(query, ".googleusercontent.com"))
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

_Not expressible for this backend: no table in this schema holds this log source_

<a id="credential-dump-detection"></a>
## LSASS Credential Dumping via Command Line

`detection-rules/sigma/windows/credential-access/credential_dump_detection.yml` | ATT&CK T1003.001 | level **critical** | status test

Detects LSASS credential dumping from the command line: Mimikatz module
syntax, ProcDump targeting lsass, or the comsvcs.dll MiniDump export run
through rundll32. Matches on arguments rather than file names, so renamed
binaries are still caught.

**Splunk**

```spl
CommandLine IN ("*sekurlsa::*", "*lsadump::*", "*kerberos::list*", "*kerberos::golden*", "*privilege::debug*", "*token::elevate*", "*vault::cred*", "*dpapi::*") OR (Image IN ("*\\procdump.exe", "*\\procdump64.exe") OR OriginalFileName="procdump*" CommandLine="*lsass*") OR (CommandLine="*comsvcs*" CommandLine IN ("*MiniDump*", "*#24*", "*#+24*"))
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where process.command_line like "*sekurlsa::*" or process.command_line like "*lsadump::*" or process.command_line like "*kerberos::list*" or process.command_line like "*kerberos::golden*" or process.command_line like "*privilege::debug*" or process.command_line like "*token::elevate*" or process.command_line like "*vault::cred*" or process.command_line like "*dpapi::*" or (ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\procdump.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\procdump64.exe") or starts_with(process.pe.original_file_name, "procdump")) and process.command_line like "*lsass*" or process.command_line like "*comsvcs*" and (process.command_line like "*MiniDump*" or process.command_line like "*#24*" or process.command_line like "*#+24*")
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

```kusto
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (ProcessCommandLine contains "sekurlsa::" or ProcessCommandLine contains "lsadump::" or ProcessCommandLine contains "kerberos::list" or ProcessCommandLine contains "kerberos::golden" or ProcessCommandLine contains "privilege::debug" or ProcessCommandLine contains "token::elevate" or ProcessCommandLine contains "vault::cred" or ProcessCommandLine contains "dpapi::") or (((FolderPath endswith "\\procdump.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\procdump64.exe") or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName startswith "procdump") and ProcessCommandLine contains "lsass") or (ProcessCommandLine contains "comsvcs" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "MiniDump" or ProcessCommandLine contains "#24" or ProcessCommandLine contains "#+24"))
```

<a id="lsass-access-sysmon"></a>
## Suspicious Process Opened LSASS with Read Access

`detection-rules/sigma/windows/credential-access/lsass_access_sysmon.yml` | ATT&CK T1003.001 | level **high** | status test

Detects a process opening lsass.exe with the access masks credential
dumpers request (PROCESS_VM_READ combinations), using Sysmon event 10.
Only specific OS and Defender binaries are excluded: excluding all of
System32 would also hide rundll32 running comsvcs.dll MiniDump.

**Splunk**

```spl
TargetImage="*\\lsass.exe" GrantedAccess IN ("0x1010", "0x1410", "0x1438", "0x143a", "0x1fffff") NOT (SourceImage IN ("C:\\Windows\\System32\\wininit.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\csrss.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\lsm.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE.exe") OR (SourceImage="C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\*" SourceImage="*\\MsMpEng.exe"))
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where ends_with(winlog.event_data.TargetImage, "\\lsass.exe") and (winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess in ("0x1010", "0x1410", "0x1438", "0x143a", "0x1fffff")) and not (process.executable.caseless in ("C:\\Windows\\System32\\wininit.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\csrss.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\lsm.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\wbem\\WmiPrvSE.exe") or starts_with(process.executable.caseless, "C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Platform\\") and ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\MsMpEng.exe"))
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

<a id="disable-windows-defender"></a>
## Microsoft Defender Disabled or Excluded via Command Line

`detection-rules/sigma/windows/defense-impairment/disable_windows_defender.yml` | ATT&CK T1685 | level **high** | status test

Detects Defender protections being switched off, or bypassed with
exclusions, through Set-MpPreference / Add-MpPreference, the service control
manager, or the DisableAntiSpyware policy value. Cmdlet and parameter are
matched independently, so reordering arguments does not evade the rule, and
explicitly re-enabling a protection ($false) is not flagged.

**Splunk**

```spl
(CommandLine="*Set-MpPreference*" CommandLine IN ("*-DisableRealtimeMonitoring*", "*-DisableBehaviorMonitoring*", "*-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen*", "*-DisableIOAVProtection*", "*-DisableScriptScanning*", "*-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem*", "*-DisableArchiveScanning*") NOT CommandLine="*$false*") OR (CommandLine="*Add-MpPreference*" CommandLine="*-Exclusion*") OR (Image IN ("*\\sc.exe", "*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") CommandLine="*WinDefend*" CommandLine IN ("* stop*", "*disabled*", "* delete*")) OR CommandLine="*DisableAntiSpyware*"
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where process.command_line like "*Set-MpPreference*" and (process.command_line like "*-DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" or process.command_line like "*-DisableBehaviorMonitoring*" or process.command_line like "*-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen*" or process.command_line like "*-DisableIOAVProtection*" or process.command_line like "*-DisableScriptScanning*" or process.command_line like "*-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem*" or process.command_line like "*-DisableArchiveScanning*") and not process.command_line like "*$false*" or process.command_line like "*Add-MpPreference*" and process.command_line like "*-Exclusion*" or (ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\sc.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\net.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\net1.exe")) and process.command_line like "*WinDefend*" and (process.command_line like "* stop*" or process.command_line like "*disabled*" or process.command_line like "* delete*") or process.command_line like "*DisableAntiSpyware*"
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

```kusto
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (ProcessCommandLine contains "Set-MpPreference" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "-DisableRealtimeMonitoring" or ProcessCommandLine contains "-DisableBehaviorMonitoring" or ProcessCommandLine contains "-DisableBlockAtFirstSeen" or ProcessCommandLine contains "-DisableIOAVProtection" or ProcessCommandLine contains "-DisableScriptScanning" or ProcessCommandLine contains "-DisableIntrusionPreventionSystem" or ProcessCommandLine contains "-DisableArchiveScanning") and (not(ProcessCommandLine contains "$false"))) or (ProcessCommandLine contains "Add-MpPreference" and ProcessCommandLine contains "-Exclusion") or ((FolderPath endswith "\\sc.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\net.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\net1.exe") and ProcessCommandLine contains "WinDefend" and (ProcessCommandLine contains " stop" or ProcessCommandLine contains "disabled" or ProcessCommandLine contains " delete")) or ProcessCommandLine contains "DisableAntiSpyware"
```

<a id="event-log-cleared-cli"></a>
## Windows Event Log Cleared from the Command Line

`detection-rules/sigma/windows/defense-impairment/event_log_cleared_cli.yml` | ATT&CK T1685.005 | level **high** | status test

Detects event logs being wiped with wevtutil, the PowerShell eventlog
cmdlets or the .NET EventLogSession API. Complements the Security 1102 /
System 104 events, which only fire after the log is already gone and can be
missing when the attacker clears logs that are not forwarded.

**Splunk**

```spl
(Image="*\\wevtutil.exe" CommandLine IN ("* cl *", "* clear-log *")) OR CommandLine IN ("*Clear-EventLog*", "*Remove-EventLog*", "*GlobalSession.ClearLog*")
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\wevtutil.exe") and (process.command_line like "* cl *" or process.command_line like "* clear-log *") or process.command_line like "*Clear-EventLog*" or process.command_line like "*Remove-EventLog*" or process.command_line like "*GlobalSession.ClearLog*"
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

```kusto
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FolderPath endswith "\\wevtutil.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains " cl " or ProcessCommandLine contains " clear-log ")) or (ProcessCommandLine contains "Clear-EventLog" or ProcessCommandLine contains "Remove-EventLog" or ProcessCommandLine contains "GlobalSession.ClearLog")
```

<a id="powershell-download-cradle"></a>
## PowerShell Download Cradle Executed in Memory

`detection-rules/sigma/windows/execution/powershell_download_cradle.yml` | ATT&CK T1059.001, T1105 | level **high** | status test

Detects PowerShell downloading content and passing it straight to
Invoke-Expression, the classic fileless loader pattern. Downloads that are
saved to disk without being executed in memory are not matched.

**Splunk**

```spl
Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine IN ("*DownloadString*", "*DownloadData*", "*Net.WebClient*", "*Invoke-WebRequest*", "*iwr *", "*Invoke-RestMethod*", "*irm *") CommandLine IN ("*IEX*", "*Invoke-Expression*")
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where (ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\powershell.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\pwsh.exe") or process.pe.original_file_name in ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll")) and (process.command_line like "*DownloadString*" or process.command_line like "*DownloadData*" or process.command_line like "*Net.WebClient*" or process.command_line like "*Invoke-WebRequest*" or process.command_line like "*iwr *" or process.command_line like "*Invoke-RestMethod*" or process.command_line like "*irm *") and (process.command_line like "*IEX*" or process.command_line like "*Invoke-Expression*")
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

```kusto
DeviceProcessEvents
| where ((FolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\pwsh.exe") or (ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName in~ ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll"))) and (ProcessCommandLine contains "DownloadString" or ProcessCommandLine contains "DownloadData" or ProcessCommandLine contains "Net.WebClient" or ProcessCommandLine contains "Invoke-WebRequest" or ProcessCommandLine contains "iwr " or ProcessCommandLine contains "Invoke-RestMethod" or ProcessCommandLine contains "irm ") and (ProcessCommandLine contains "IEX" or ProcessCommandLine contains "Invoke-Expression")
```

<a id="shadow-copy-deletion"></a>
## Shadow Copy or Backup Catalog Destroyed

`detection-rules/sigma/windows/impact/shadow_copy_deletion.yml` | ATT&CK T1490 | level **high** | status test

Detects the recovery-inhibition step most ransomware runs before
encrypting: deleting or shrinking Volume Shadow Copies, deleting the backup
catalog, or disabling Windows Recovery. Any one of the variants matches.

**Splunk**

```spl
(Image="*\\vssadmin.exe" CommandLine="*delete*" CommandLine="*shadows*") OR (Image="*\\vssadmin.exe" CommandLine="*resize*" CommandLine="*shadowstorage*") OR (Image="*\\wmic.exe" CommandLine="*shadowcopy*" CommandLine="*delete*") OR (Image="*\\wbadmin.exe" CommandLine="*delete*" CommandLine="*catalog*") OR (Image="*\\bcdedit.exe" CommandLine IN ("*recoveryenabled no*", "*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*")) OR (CommandLine="*Win32_ShadowCopy*" CommandLine="*Delete*")
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\vssadmin.exe") and process.command_line like "*delete*" and process.command_line like "*shadows*" or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\vssadmin.exe") and process.command_line like "*resize*" and process.command_line like "*shadowstorage*" or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\wmic.exe") and process.command_line like "*shadowcopy*" and process.command_line like "*delete*" or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\wbadmin.exe") and process.command_line like "*delete*" and process.command_line like "*catalog*" or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\bcdedit.exe") and (process.command_line like "*recoveryenabled no*" or process.command_line like "*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*") or process.command_line like "*Win32_ShadowCopy*" and process.command_line like "*Delete*"
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

```kusto
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FolderPath endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "delete" and ProcessCommandLine contains "shadows")) or (FolderPath endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "resize" and ProcessCommandLine contains "shadowstorage")) or (FolderPath endswith "\\wmic.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine contains "delete")) or (FolderPath endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "delete" and ProcessCommandLine contains "catalog")) or (FolderPath endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "recoveryenabled no" or ProcessCommandLine contains "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures")) or (ProcessCommandLine contains "Win32_ShadowCopy" and ProcessCommandLine contains "Delete")
```

<a id="wmiprvse-spawns-shell"></a>
## WMI Provider Host Spawned a Shell or Script Host

`detection-rules/sigma/windows/lateral-movement/wmiprvse_spawns_shell.yml` | ATT&CK T1047 | level **high** | status test

Detects WmiPrvSE.exe starting cmd, PowerShell or a script host, the
target-side footprint of remote WMI execution (wmic /node, Impacket
wmiexec, Invoke-WmiMethod). Catches lateral movement even when the source
host is not monitored.

**Splunk**

```spl
ParentImage="*\\WmiPrvSE.exe" Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\mshta.exe", "*\\rundll32.exe", "*\\regsvr32.exe", "*\\wscript.exe", "*\\cscript.exe")
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where ends_with(process.parent.executable.caseless, "\\WmiPrvSE.exe") and (ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\cmd.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\powershell.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\pwsh.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\mshta.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\rundll32.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\regsvr32.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\wscript.exe") or ends_with(process.executable.caseless, "\\cscript.exe"))
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

```kusto
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\WmiPrvSE.exe" and (FolderPath endswith "\\cmd.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\pwsh.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\mshta.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\rundll32.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\regsvr32.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\wscript.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\cscript.exe")
```

<a id="registry-run-key-suspicious-path"></a>
## Run Key Persistence Pointing at a Staging Path or Script Host

`detection-rules/sigma/windows/persistence/registry_run_key_suspicious_path.yml` | ATT&CK T1547.001 | level **high** | status test

Detects Run / RunOnce values whose data launches a script host or LOLBin,
or a binary in a world-writable staging folder. Legitimate per-user apps
usually autostart from Program Files or AppData\Roaming / Local\Programs,
which are deliberately not matched.

**Splunk**

```spl
TargetObject IN ("*\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*", "*\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*", "*\\SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*") Details IN ("*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "*powershell*", "*mshta*", "*wscript*", "*cscript*", "*rundll32*", "*regsvr32*")
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where (registry.path like "*\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*" or registry.path like "*\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*" or registry.path like "*\\SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\*") and (winlog.event_data.Details like "*\\Users\\Public\\*" or winlog.event_data.Details like "*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" or winlog.event_data.Details like "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" or winlog.event_data.Details like "*powershell*" or winlog.event_data.Details like "*mshta*" or winlog.event_data.Details like "*wscript*" or winlog.event_data.Details like "*cscript*" or winlog.event_data.Details like "*rundll32*" or winlog.event_data.Details like "*regsvr32*")
```

**Microsoft Defender XDR / Sentinel**

```kusto
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where (RegistryKey endswith "\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run*" or RegistryKey endswith "\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce*" or RegistryKey endswith "\\SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run*") and (RegistryValueData contains "\\Users\\Public\\" or RegistryValueData contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\" or RegistryValueData contains "\\Windows\\Temp\\" or RegistryValueData contains "powershell" or RegistryValueData contains "mshta" or RegistryValueData contains "wscript" or RegistryValueData contains "cscript" or RegistryValueData contains "rundll32" or RegistryValueData contains "regsvr32")
```

<a id="schtask-creation"></a>
## Scheduled Task Created with a Script Host or User-Writable Action

`detection-rules/sigma/windows/persistence/schtask_creation.yml` | ATT&CK T1053.005 | level **medium** | status test

Detects scheduled tasks (Security event 4698) whose action runs a script
host or LOLBin, or a binary from a user-writable folder. It keys on what
the task executes rather than its name, since attackers name tasks after
updaters and every browser ships a real "Update" task.

**Splunk**

```spl
source="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4698 TaskContent IN ("*\\AppData\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "*powershell*", "*pwsh*", "*mshta*", "*wscript*", "*cscript*", "*rundll32*", "*regsvr32*", "*cmd.exe /c*", "*cmd /c*") NOT TaskName="\\Microsoft\\*"
```

**Elastic (ES|QL)**

```sql
from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where winlog.channel=="Security" and event.code=="4698" and (winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*\\AppData\\*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*\\Users\\Public\\*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*powershell*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*pwsh*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*mshta*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*wscript*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*cscript*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*rundll32*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*regsvr32*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*cmd.exe /c*" or winlog.event_data.TaskContent like "*cmd /c*") and not starts_with(winlog.event_data.TaskName, "\\Microsoft\\")
```
